01/07/2026

#### How to Choose the Right High-Speed Dynamometer System for EV Testing

A high-speed dynamometer system measures torque, speed, and power output from electric powertrains
across a controlled load range. Selecting the right system is critical for validating motor
efficiency, inverter behavior, thermal performance, and drivetrain durability. atestman delivers
high-speed dynamometer solutions trusted by automotive, military, and aerospace programs worldwide,
combining precision measurement hardware with flexible test automation.

Read More >>
][53]
[
01/07/2026

#### The Ultimate Guide to E-Drive EMC Test Benches for EV Powertrain Testing

An e-drive EMC test bench is a controlled chamber-and-dyno system that measures electromagnetic
emissions and immunity of EV powertrains. Atestman builds test systems that align with CISPR 25, ISO
11452, and major OEM component-level EMC requirements. These systems help suppliers validate motors
and inverters before mass production.

Read More >>
][54]
[
31/05/2026

#### How Atestman E-Drive EMC Test Benches Support 800V and SiC Architectures

As electric vehicles advance, the adoption of 800V architectures and Silicon Carbide (SiC) power
electronics is becoming increasingly common to improve efficiency, reduce weight, and enable faster
charging. However, these high-voltage, high-speed systems also introduce new electromagnetic
compatibility (EMC) challenges, including stronger radiated and conducted emissions. Early detection
and mitigation of these issues are critical to ensure system reliability, reduce development costs,
and avoid costly late-stage redesigns.

Read More >>
][55]

#### Why E-Drive EMC Test Bench Matters

An E-Drive EMC Test Bench is a specialized system that tests the electromagnetic interference of EV
motors and inverters under real driving conditions, which is absolutely vital because it ensures
high-voltage components don't disrupt critical safety electronics like brakes or sensors, guarantees
the vehicle passes global regulatory standards for market entry, and catches costly design flaws
early in development before mass production.

01/07/2026

#### How to Choose the Right High-Speed Dynamometer System for EV Testing

A high-speed dynamometer system measures torque, speed, and power output from electric powertrains
across a controlled load range. Selecting the right system is critical for validating motor
efficiency, inverter behavior, thermal performance, and drivetrain durability. atestman delivers
high-speed dynamometer solutions trusted by automotive, military, and aerospace programs worldwide,
combining precision measurement hardware with flexible test automation.

Read More >>
][53]
[
01/07/2026

#### The Ultimate Guide to E-Drive EMC Test Benches for EV Powertrain Testing

An e-drive EMC test bench is a controlled chamber-and-dyno system that measures electromagnetic
emissions and immunity of EV powertrains. Atestman builds test systems that align with CISPR 25, ISO
11452, and major OEM component-level EMC requirements. These systems help suppliers validate motors
and inverters before mass production.

Read More >>
][54]
[
31/05/2026

#### How Atestman E-Drive EMC Test Benches Support 800V and SiC Architectures

As electric vehicles advance, the adoption of 800V architectures and Silicon Carbide (SiC) power
electronics is becoming increasingly common to improve efficiency, reduce weight, and enable faster
charging. However, these high-voltage, high-speed systems also introduce new electromagnetic
compatibility (EMC) challenges, including stronger radiated and conducted emissions. Early detection
and mitigation of these issues are critical to ensure system reliability, reduce development costs,
and avoid costly late-stage redesigns.

Read More >>
][55]

#### Why E-Drive EMC Test Bench Matters

An E-Drive EMC Test Bench is a specialized system that tests the electromagnetic interference of EV
motors and inverters under real driving conditions, which is absolutely vital because it ensures
high-voltage components don't disrupt critical safety electronics like brakes or sensors, guarantees
the vehicle passes global regulatory standards for market entry, and catches costly design flaws
early in development before mass production.

EXBA18V-80
GKE18V-20N

New Products

### EXBA18V-80
* High-power tabless cell technology – provides lower inner resistance for reduced battery heating,
  increased power, longer runtime and optimized performance
* Outstanding power and runtime – deliver up to 140% more instantaneous maximum power* and up to
  120% longer runtime** than the core18v® 4 ah battery (gba18v40)
* Bosch-exclusive coolpack™ 2.0 technology – cools the battery and helps provide longer lifetime
  compared to non-coolpack™ bosch 18v batteries

[ Product details ][231]

New Products

### GKE18V-20N
* 8 in bar length – delivers a large cutting area to increase efficiency
* Brushless motor – delivers efficient power and a 23.6 ft/s chain speed for fast, consistent
  cutting with extended runtime
* High cuts per charge – for up to 350 cuts per charge with a 18V 4 Ah battery (sold separately)
  when cutting 2”x2” pressure-treated wood

[ Product details ][232]

New Products

### GSC18V-16EN
* Efficient brushless motor – provides an equivalent of 700w of corded power for fast, clean cuts
* Lightweight, ergonomic design – with slim, soft grip for enhanced comfort and reduced fatigue
* Robust design – with maintenance-free components for durable use

[ Product details ][233]

### What We Do

## Innovative EV Solution For Your Projects

We provide tailored EV solutions designed to meet your project requirements — from solution design
and system integration to calibration, testing, and delivery — all backed by comprehensive technical
support. Our solutions cover key EV systems with cutting-edge technologies, including electric
powertrain systems (motors, e-axles, controllers), battery systems (battery packs, BMS, BTMS, PDU),
steering and braking systems, and more. Designed for commercial applications such as trucks, buses,
trains, agriculture, construction, and mining equipment, our solutions help OEMs steamline sourcing,
reduce costs, and accelerate project timelines.
* Industry-Leading Technology to Keep You Ahead in the EV Industry

Once we receive your inquiry, our experts will connect with you within two business days to
understand your specific requirements for the EV solution and conduct an initial feasibility
evaluation of your project.

### Project & Technical Coordination

If the project is deemed feasible, our engineering team will collaborate closely with your team on
both hardware and software aspects to develop a viable solution. We will also provide a detailed
quotation based on the technical requirements.

### Development, Manufacturing & Testing

For customized or modified systems, we proceed with product development, including hardware and
software adaptations. Our EV systems undergo rigorous testing to ensure quality, reliability, and
full functionality before deployment.

### In-Time Global Shipping & Delivery

We have established strong partnerships with international shipping providers, ensuring safe and
timely delivery of products to your specified location. This guarantees a smooth and efficient
deployment of your EV project.

We provide technical support throughout the entire project lifecycle, including consultancy,
hardware and software development, calibration, and both onsite and remote debugging, ensuring

### What We Do

## Innovative EV Solution For Your Projects

We provide tailored EV solutions designed to meet your project requirements — from solution design
and system integration to calibration, testing, and delivery — all backed by comprehensive technical
support. Our solutions cover key EV systems with cutting-edge technologies, including electric
powertrain systems (motors, e-axles, controllers), battery systems (battery packs, BMS, BTMS, PDU),
steering and braking systems, and more. Designed for commercial applications such as trucks, buses,
trains, agriculture, construction, and mining equipment, our solutions help OEMs steamline sourcing,
reduce costs, and accelerate project timelines.
* Industry-Leading Technology to Keep You Ahead in the EV Industry
* Customizable Solutions Tailored to Your Specific Project Needs
* Reliable, High-Efficiency EV Systems to Power Your Electrification Projects

If the project is deemed feasible, our engineering team will collaborate closely with your team on

For customized or modified systems, we proceed with product development, including hardware and

### In-Time Global Shipping & Delivery

We have established strong partnerships with international shipping providers, ensuring safe and
timely delivery of products to your specified location. This guarantees a smooth and efficient
deployment of your EV project.

We provide technical support throughout the entire project lifecycle, including consultancy,
hardware and software development, calibration, and both onsite and remote debugging, ensuring
optimal performance and long-term success.

#### What EV powertrain solutions does Brogen offer?

Brogen provides complete EV powertrain solutions for commercial and industrial vehicles, including
e-axles, e-motors, battery packs, and auxiliary systems.

#### What types of vehicles does Brogen support?

We focus on commercial electric vehicles including electric buses, trucks, construction equipment,
and special purpose vehicles and related applications.

#### What EV battery solutions does Brogen provide?

We provide lithium battery systems for commercial electric vehicles, including battery packs,
battery management systems, and thermal management solutions.

#### Does Brogen support small volume or prototype projects?

Yes, we support low-volume production and prototype development for commercial EV programs,
including early-stage testing and flexible customization options.

#### Can Brogen provide pricing without a defined project?

No. Accurate pricing requires a defined electric vehicle project. EV powertrain systems depend on
vehicle parameters, duty cycle, and integration requirements.

#### How does Brogen ensure system compatibility?

We perform system level matching across electric motors, inverters, battery systems, and e-axles
based on real vehicle requirements and operating conditions.

rotational mechanical energy to drive the wheels of the truck. The motor can be either an AC
(alternating current) or DC (direct current) motor, depending on the design and requirements of the
powertrain.

automobile industry as its core business. The company is committed to the development, manufacture,
sales, and service of electric drive systems, and cooperates with many automobile manufacturers to
provide customers with high-quality products and efficient solutions in the field of automotive
power supply. The main products are electric vehicle powertrain, power supply assembly, drive motor,
motor controller, DC-DC converter, and other core components in the power field of the electric
vehicles. With high efficiency, lightweight, low cost, and other significant advantages of electric
vehicle drive units and electric drive unit components, and have cooperated well-known brand
customers like Daimler, Continental, and Ford etc. We sincerely look forward to cooperating with
more customers at home and abroad

## **Top Coolest Headquarters in the World**

Discover the top coolest headquarters and corporate offices in the world—iconic workplaces known for
innovative design, creative architecture, and inspiring office environments. These world-class
company headquarters set new standards for modern corporate office culture, blending functionality
with bold aesthetics to create spaces that employees genuinely enjoy working in every day.

From cutting-edge technology campuses to architecturally stunning corporate offices, these
headquarters showcase how thoughtful design, open collaboration spaces, and employee-focused
amenities can transform the workplace experience. Each headquarters highlights unique approaches to
office layout, sustainability, wellness, and creativity, making them a powerful source of
inspiration for corporate office management teams and business leaders worldwide.

To explore these incredible headquarters in action and see what makes them stand out, watch the

If you have ever wondered what it would be like to work in a truly inspiring corporate environment,
these headquarters represent the ultimate vision of modern office life. They are not just
offices—they are destinations that reflect company culture, innovation, and forward-thinking
leadership, and they continue to influence how organizations design and manage their headquarters
across the globe.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:
* **Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Office** – Responsible for overall vision, leadership, and
  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Together, these offices form the operational and strategic core of a company, making the
headquarters the central hub for leadership, planning, and decision-making.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:

  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Eaton's programmable logic  controllers are solid-state, electronic devices that control the
operation of a machine or processes and monitor inputs from sources like pressure sensors,
temperature sensors, limit switches, auxiliary contacts, and pilot devices.

Eaton’s M22 and M30 pushbutton portfolio features a wide range of modular and ergonomically designed

# Heavy-duty Mobile Equipment Engineering

MEDATech equips businesses with the strategy, engineering, and products they need to scale—fusing
cutting-edge tech with heavy duty mobile equipment know-how. We are your bandwidth for business
growth.

## MECHANICAL/STRUCTURAL DESIGN & BUILD  •  CONTROL SYSTEMS, SOFTWARE & AUTOMATION HYDRAULIC & FLUID
## SYSTEMS  •  ELECTRICAL DESIGN  •  HYBRID & ELECTRIC DRIVETRAINS

## [Design, Build, Deliver.][21]

From project consulting to equipment design and development, from controls system development to
telematics and robotics, MEDATech’s in-house, multi-disciplinary engineering team can do it all.

## [Battery Electric Platforms][22]

Modular, scalable, and field-supported powertrain systems designed to meet specific duty cycle
requirements. AltDrive is a perfect solution for companies looking to leapfrog past years of
development work in the electrification or hybrid electrification of their heavy duty mobile
equipment.

## [Specialty Drilling Solutions][23]

Advanced drilling solutions for the most demanding applications. Design, integration, and delivery
of custom-built rigs, automated rod-handling systems, and electrified drilling technologies for both
underground and surface drilling.

[**View our Latest Newsletter**][24]

## We are the world’s leading integrator of mobile equipment technology. Through our unique
## expertise in engineered design, strategic manufacturing, and application knowledge, we are paving
## the way for safety and productivity gains across industries, leveraging the power of automation,
## electrification, and digitalization.

# Your partner for customized electric motors - trusted since 1927

As a German manufacturer, we offer individual motor solutions worldwide. Our quick adaptations and
customized designs u**p to 25 MW and 13.8 kV **ensure the smooth operation of your industrial
machinery.

Don't want to miss any news? Then sign up for our free [newsletter today][78]!

## Electric Motor Production for Industrial Plants

Powerful industrial motors - customized for your applications

MENZEL develops and manufactures large electric motors with an output of **up to 25 MW
**specifically for **demanding industrial processes**. Our motors drive e.g. cement mills, steel
rollers, mine fans, compressors,  or pump systems** worldwide.** Whether custom-made or our own
motor series with high levels of efficiency - we supply motors that are **precisely tailored **to
your technical requirements. 

## Technical Consulting and Motor Design

Electric motors precisely designed for your application

The **optimum liability** of an electric motor is only achieved through the precise design of the
entire drive system. With almost** 100 years of experience** and our own **engineering department**,
we precisely match the required drive components to each other. Our experts analyze the grid,
switch-on and operating conditions and **provide support** in optimally adapting our motor to your
application.

## Fast Solution Directly from Stock

Large motors up to 25,000 kW directy from the warehouse

MENZEL maintains one of the **largest stocks of large industrial motors** in Europe. We have both
three-phase asynchronous **squirrel cage motors, slip ring motors and DC motors** in a wide range of
sizes in stock at all times - including special designs. Our extensive warehousing concept and
our **flexible in-house processing** enable us to offer unique response times and individual
customization of stock motors.

## Customized Motor Solutions, Fast Replacement Deliveries, and Special Designs

Many of our customers come to us **when they cannot find a standard solution** or when a damaged or
obsolete motor needs to be replaced immediately. Thanks to a uniquely large motor warehouse and
flexible manufacturing processes, we offer:

✔ **Custom-made motors for demanding operating conditions** - including motor designs that are no
longer common today

✔** Fast availability worldwide** - we supply and install electric motors anywhere. On request, our
experts can carry out commissioning on site

✔ **State-of-the-art production & comprehensive quality testing** - we carry out all key processing
steps in our own motor factory - with state-of-the-art machines, our own welding shop, paint shop
and a highly specialized motor test field

✔ **Transparency & quality** - our customers are invited to follow the motor tests live on site from
a comfortable lounge

> We are not just salespeople - we are solution finders. With the highest precision, craftsmanship,
> technical know-how and decades of experience, we ensure quality, durability and maximum
> operational reliability.
> 
> Guido Wolf
> Graduate Engineer and Head of High Voltage Motors

## [Menzel Motor Manufacturing since 1927][102]

MENZEL has been in the electric motor manufacturing business **since 1927**. The medium-sized,
**completly independed company** is known for its swiftness and flexibility - whether in responding
to customer inquiries or in processing **high and low-voltage motors, DC motors,** transformers and
frequency converters.** **All of our AC and DC motors comply with the current standards **EN60034
and IEC60034, VDE, DIN and ISO**.

MENZEL has **branches **in Sweden, France, Great Britain, Italy, Romania, and Spain and cooperates
with numerous **partners worldwide**. [Pawils Elektromaschinenbau GmbH ][103]in Peine, Germany, has
been part of the corporate family as a wholly-owned subsidiary since 2011.  We see ourselves as a
long-term oriented partner and consultant to the industry. As a **family business,** MENZEL is
constantly working on open and respectful cooperation within the workforce. Menzel is a signatory to
the “Diversity Charter”.

# Your partner for customized electric motors - trusted since 1927

As a German manufacturer, we offer individual motor solutions worldwide. Our quick adaptations and
customized designs u**p to 25 MW and 13.8 kV **ensure the smooth operation of your industrial
machinery.

Don't want to miss any news? Then sign up for our free [newsletter today][78]!

## Electric Motor Production for Industrial Plants

Powerful industrial motors - customized for your applications

MENZEL develops and manufactures large electric motors with an output of **up to 25 MW
**specifically for **demanding industrial processes**. Our motors drive e.g. cement mills, steel
rollers, mine fans, compressors,  or pump systems** worldwide.** Whether custom-made or our own
motor series with high levels of efficiency - we supply motors that are **precisely tailored **to
your technical requirements. 

## Technical Consulting and Motor Design

Electric motors precisely designed for your application

The **optimum liability** of an electric motor is only achieved through the precise design of the
entire drive system. With almost** 100 years of experience** and our own **engineering department**,
we precisely match the required drive components to each other. Our experts analyze the grid,
switch-on and operating conditions and **provide support** in optimally adapting our motor to your
application.

## Fast Solution Directly from Stock

Large motors up to 25,000 kW directy from the warehouse

MENZEL maintains one of the **largest stocks of large industrial motors** in Europe. We have both
three-phase asynchronous **squirrel cage motors, slip ring motors and DC motors** in a wide range of
sizes in stock at all times - including special designs. Our extensive warehousing concept and
our **flexible in-house processing** enable us to offer unique response times and individual
customization of stock motors.

## Customized Motor Solutions, Fast Replacement Deliveries, and Special Designs

Many of our customers come to us **when they cannot find a standard solution** or when a damaged or
obsolete motor needs to be replaced immediately. Thanks to a uniquely large motor warehouse and
flexible manufacturing processes, we offer:

✔ **Custom-made motors for demanding operating conditions** - including motor designs that are no
longer common today

✔** Fast availability worldwide** - we supply and install electric motors anywhere. On request, our
experts can carry out commissioning on site

✔ **State-of-the-art production & comprehensive quality testing** - we carry out all key processing
steps in our own motor factory - with state-of-the-art machines, our own welding shop, paint shop
and a highly specialized motor test field

✔ **Transparency & quality** - our customers are invited to follow the motor tests live on site from
a comfortable lounge

> We are not just salespeople - we are solution finders. With the highest precision, craftsmanship,
> technical know-how and decades of experience, we ensure quality, durability and maximum
> operational reliability.
> 
> Guido Wolf
> Graduate Engineer and Head of High Voltage Motors

## [Menzel Motor Manufacturing since 1927][102]

MENZEL has been in the electric motor manufacturing business **since 1927**. The medium-sized,
**completly independed company** is known for its swiftness and flexibility - whether in responding
to customer inquiries or in processing **high and low-voltage motors, DC motors,** transformers and
frequency converters.** **All of our AC and DC motors comply with the current standards **EN60034
and IEC60034, VDE, DIN and ISO**.

MENZEL has **branches **in Sweden, France, Great Britain, Italy, Romania, and Spain and cooperates
with numerous **partners worldwide**. [Pawils Elektromaschinenbau GmbH ][103]in Peine, Germany, has
been part of the corporate family as a wholly-owned subsidiary since 2011.  We see ourselves as a
long-term oriented partner and consultant to the industry. As a **family business,** MENZEL is
constantly working on open and respectful cooperation within the workforce. Menzel is a signatory to
the “Diversity Charter”.

#### who we are

### Welcome to Pavletich Electric & Communications

Pavletich Electric & Communications, Inc. and Pav-Solar is an Electrical, Communications and Solar
contractor with offices in Bakersfield and Visalia, California. We provide wiring services and
products for tract, custom, multi-family homes, and apartment complexes, including remodels of
existing facilities throughout California. Additionally, we supply and install power and lighting
for commercial buildings, commercial and industrial wiring of buildings and design build projects of
all size, restaurants, and schools. We also install data and fiber optic cabling systems for
commercial campus based networks and provide underground and overhead conduit pathways for power,
data, and fiber optic cables. Our Communications division provides fiber optic cable splicing,
termination and restoration services to the communications industry. We invite you to visit our
office and warehouse located in Bakersfield at 6308 Seven Seas Avenue and located in Visalia at 9746
West Grove Avenue.

leading automotive manufacturers to integrate advanced technologies into electric vehicles,
enhancing performance, efficiency, and sustainability. Our patented technologies drive innovation in
battery management systems, electric drivetrains, and smart charging solutions, paving the way for a
greener automotive future

In the General Industry sector, PROSPEXA provides cutting-edge solutions that optimize production
processes, increase efficiency, and reduce costs. Our technologies cater to various industrial
applications, from manufacturing to logistics, offering bespoke solutions that meet the unique needs
of each client. By implementing our innovative approaches, companies can achieve operational
excellence and stay ahead in a competitive market

licensing, joint development or regional production cooperation.

strategies.

Custom motor architecture for UAV and drone propulsion applications.

Relevant applications:
* Multirotor drones
* FPV platforms
* Fixed-wing UAVs

* Long-endurance UAV platforms
* Special-purpose aerospace systems

## Advanced Tech: Renewable Energy

Renewable Energy is at the forefront of our advanced technology offerings. PROSPEXA is dedicated to
promoting sustainable energy solutions, including solar, wind, and bioenergy technologies. We help
businesses transition to renewable energy sources, reducing their carbon footprint and contributing
to global environmental goals. Our expertise in energy storage, grid integration, and smart energy
management ensures the efficient and reliable deployment of renewable energy systems
 

Generator and drive concepts for specific operating conditions.

PROSPEXA’s platform can be adapted for renewable energy, low-RPM generation, industrial drives and
other applications where compactness, thermal stability, material flexibility and scalability are
important.

Relevant applications:
* Wind energy
* Low-RPM generators
* Hydro applications
* Gravity battery systems
* Marine energy
* Industrial electric drives
* Special-purpose generators
   

[Discuss Generator Applications][43]

## Medical Equipment

In the Medical Equipment sector, PROSPEXA partners with healthcare innovators to bring cutting-edge
medical devices to market. Our technologies enhance diagnostic accuracy, treatment efficacy, and
patient care. From advanced imaging systems to wearable health monitors, we support the development
and commercialization of medical equipment that improves healthcare outcomes and quality of life.
Our commitment to innovation ensures that the medical industry can meet the evolving needs of
patients and healthcare professionals.

* environmental friendliness - heat loss reduction by 20-30%

## Lead. Inspire. Build.

Since 1919, our reputation has been founded on building quality electrical and communications
installations, building value for clients, and building people in a diverse, safe, and inclusive
environment. We serve customers with highly complex construction projects, who rely on us for
knowledge, scalability, quality, and safety. Infused with a sense of shared ownership, our entire
team focuses on building relationships that deliver results.

[
Our Mission, Vision & Values Our Mission, Vision & Values Our Mission, Vision & Values
][102]

## Core values that guide us

### We Care

We are an organization built on integrity. We create an environment that empowers people to work
safely, be at their best, and respect one another.

### We Listen

Our success is based on hearing and understanding the objectives of our customers and employees. We
build relationships.

### We Share

We collaborate, inspire and challenge one another.

### We Innovate

People will remember us for the solutions we provide. Entrepreneurial ideas are encouraged to
continuously raise industry standards.

### We Excel

The quality of our work will represent us for years to come. We take pride in what we build. It is
our legacy.

## Lead. Inspire. Build.

Since 1919, our reputation has been founded on building quality electrical and communications
installations, building value for clients, and building people in a diverse, safe, and inclusive
environment. We serve customers with highly complex construction projects, who rely on us for
knowledge, scalability, quality, and safety. Infused with a sense of shared ownership, our entire
team focuses on building relationships that deliver results.

[
Our Mission, Vision & Values Our Mission, Vision & Values Our Mission, Vision & Values
][102]

## Core values that guide us

### We Care

We are an organization built on integrity. We create an environment that empowers people to work
safely, be at their best, and respect one another.

### We Listen

Our success is based on hearing and understanding the objectives of our customers and employees. We
build relationships.

### We Share

We collaborate, inspire and challenge one another.

### We Innovate

People will remember us for the solutions we provide. Entrepreneurial ideas are encouraged to
continuously raise industry standards.

### We Excel

The quality of our work will represent us for years to come. We take pride in what we build. It is
our legacy.

As a specialized supplement ingredient supplier, SED Ingredients focuses on supplying high-quality

As the one of the leading pharma API suppliers worldwide, we offer integral components in the
front-end processes of API manufacturing, our intermediates play a vital role in creating both
pharmaceutical and chemical raw materials. Explore our selection of biological and chemical API
intermediates, where quality and reliable service are our top priorities.

Anticancer APIs are substances used in the formulation of cancer treatment drugs. These substances
can interfere with the growth of cancer cells and inhibit their spread through a specific mode of
action.

and improve insulin sensitivity through different mechanisms to achieve the purpose of controlling

variety of dosage forms like capsules, tablets, gelatin, etc. with diverse functions and wide
applications.

Cardiovascular APIs are used in medications developing to treat cardiovascular related diseases.

cholesterol levels, preventing thrombosis, etc.

Энергия. Технологии. Надежность.

Систэм Электрик (Systeme Electric) – российская производственная компания с мировой экспертизой. Мы
предлагаем комплексные решения в области электроэнергии и промышленной автоматизации и делаем
процессы безопасными, эффективными и технологичными.

В 2022 году Schneider Electric (Шнайдер Электрик) приняла решение продать российские активы местному
менеджменту. Так появилась компания Systeme Electric.

# Systeme Electric — оборудование и комплексные решения для управления электроэнергией

[О компании][209] [Продукты][210] [Решения][211] [Сделано в России][212] [Российские

Энергия. Технологии. Надежность.

Систэм Электрик (Systeme Electric) – российская производственная компания с мировой экспертизой. Мы
предлагаем комплексные решения в области электроэнергии и промышленной автоматизации и делаем
процессы безопасными, эффективными и технологичными.

В 2022 году Schneider Electric (Шнайдер Электрик) приняла решение продать российские активы местному
менеджменту. Так появилась компания Systeme Electric.

Мы предоставляем продукты и решения для управления электроэнергией, промышленной автоматизации, IT и

# About Our Company

Dutch Thrustleader Marine Propulsion (Jiangsu) Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of the Dutch brand Dutch
Thrustleader, founded in 2007 in the Netherlands and established in China in 2017 to meet growing
global demand. The company integrates R&D, engineering, and manufacturing, leveraging advanced
Chinese industrial resources. With a 10,000 m² production area, our facility includes specialized
assembly and testing workshops. We are certified under GB/T19001-2016 / ISO9001:2015 and hold CCS
and BV factory accreditations. Our R&D center is supported by two postdoctoral advisors and a team
of experienced European and Chinese engineers. We design and manufacture a wide range of marine
propulsion systems, including tunnel thrusters, azimuth thrusters, deck-mounted and retractable
azimuth thrusters, along with advanced control systems. Power output ranges from 30 kW to 6000 kW,
with integration options for dynamic positioning systems. For the renewable energy sector, we offer
battery-powered and hybrid propulsion systems, unmanned vessel control solutions, and customized pod
thrusters. All systems can be delivered under major classification societies such as CCS, DNV-GL,
LR, ABS, BV, RINA, NK, RMRS, and CRS. Our mission is to build Dutch Thrustleader into a world-class
brand—customer-focused, reliable, and innovative.

### USB Versions

USB 2.0: A cost-effective option that is perfect for everyday transfers, giveaways, and data that
doesn’t require fast transfer speeds. It’s compatible with almost any device and is a reliable
choice.

USB 3.1: This offers faster read and write speeds. If you are handling large files such as software
applications and high-resolution images, and efficiency is a priority, this version is best for you.

### USB Connectors

USB Type-A: The most common USB connector type. Used across computers, laptops, and many other
devices. If you’re looking for maximum compatibility and promotional distribution, USB Type-A is
your best choice.

USB Type-C: Ideal for modern devices and tech-savvy users. Newer computers, laptops, and smartphones
use USB-C ports and offer faster data transfer speeds.

Need the best of both worlds? We offer styles with dual connectors that offer both connector types
for more transferability between different devices.

### USB Versions

USB 2.0: A cost-effective option that is perfect for everyday transfers, giveaways, and data that
doesn’t require fast transfer speeds. It’s compatible with almost any device and is a reliable
choice.

USB 3.1: This offers faster read and write speeds. If you are handling large files such as software
applications and high-resolution images, and efficiency is a priority, this version is best for you.

### USB Connectors

USB Type-A: The most common USB connector type. Used across computers, laptops, and many other
devices. If you’re looking for maximum compatibility and promotional distribution, USB Type-A is
your best choice.

USB Type-C: Ideal for modern devices and tech-savvy users. Newer computers, laptops, and smartphones
use USB-C ports and offer faster data transfer speeds.

Need the best of both worlds? We offer styles with dual connectors that offer both connector types
for more transferability between different devices.

Data Services

We offer additional services that can save you a lot of time, such as data Duplication, permanent
uploads, and much more.

Branding Options

engraving, heat stamping, screen printing, and digital full-color print.

Our team helps you choose the right style, capacity, print method, packaging, and delivery timeline
so your order looks professional and arrives when you need it.

We are transparent about our pricing and have no hidden costs or extra fees. When ordering [USB
flash drives in bulk][74], we offer the most competitive wholesale prices.

### How WISEDRV Enabled Link Tour's Revolutionary 'Alumi' Vehicle

Link Tour positions "Alumi" as a highly futuristic urban transportation solution. The core of this
lies in the adoption of an innovative all-aluminum body, with the entire vehicle design centered
around extreme lightweighting and sustainability. The application of the all-aluminum body has also
brought a series of cutting-edge technical challenges to the vehicle development and
engineering.      Integrated with the all-aluminum body The application of the
flat-wire motor can effectively enhance the overall efficiency and power performance of the vehicle.
However, the deep integration of the flat-wire motor with the all-aluminum body presents several
technical challenges in terms of thermal management and space layout. Thermal management
coordination issue Under high power density conditions, the internal heat of the flat-wire motor is
more concentrated. The all-aluminum body has excellent heat conductivity, which not only enhances
the overall heat dissipation potential but also makes it easier for the heat from the motor to be
transferred to the chassis and the surrounding cabin, thus placing higher demands on the precise
control of cabin thermal comfort. Therefore, a more efficient oil-cooling system needs to be
developed to achieve precise management of the motor's heat, which also poses higher technical
requirements for the integrated design of the cooling system. Space layout integration issue The
high power density design helps to reduce the size of the motor, creating conditions for optimizing
the interior space. To achieve the lightweighting goal, the chassis and body structure of
all-aluminum vehicles generally adopt a compact layout. Under this premise, although the volume of
the flat-wire motor has an advantage, its installation and layout still need to be precisely matched
with key components such as the suspension geometry and collision energy absorption structure, which
constitutes an important technical issue in multi-system collaborative design.   
Synergistic improvement of lightweighting and NVH performance During the development of all-aluminum
body structures, the simultaneous optimization of lightweighting goals and NVH performance is an
important technical issue in engineering implementation. The density of aluminum alloy is
approximately one-third that of steel, which brings significant lightweighting advantages. However,
the vibration damping characteristics of the material itself differ from those of steel. During
vehicle operation, the high-frequency electromagnetic vibration of the flat-wire motor and the
subtle vibrations caused by road excitation are more prominent in the aluminum body structure. This
poses a corresponding technical issue for controlling the interior quietness. To achieve better NVH
performance, adjustments can be made through the arrangement of sound insulation and vibration
reduction materials, optimization of damping structures, and active noise reduction technologies.

performance, adjustments can be made through the arrangement of sound insulation and vibration
